title: Strength Training for Patients — Load, Effort and Safe Progression

hook.en: Strength is the most powerful tool in rehabilitation, and the one most often under-dosed. Patients stay on the same light weights for months, or jump the load and flare up. Learn a simple way to set the effort, progress step by step and keep pain on your side.
hook.ur: Taqat rehab ka sab se taqatwar hathiyar hai, aur sab se zyada kam dose mein diya jane wala bhi. Mareez mahinon ek hi halke wazan par rehte hain, ya load ek dam barha kar dard bhara dete hain. Effort tay karne, qadam ba qadam aage barhne aur dard ko apne saath rakhne ka saada tareeqa seekhein.

goal.en: By the end, you'll choose a starting load by effort, use reps in reserve (RIR) and rate of perceived exertion (RPE), progress one variable at a time with the two-for-two rule, manage pain with a simple traffic-light, and explain to a patient why strength comes before size.
goal.ur: End tak aap effort se shuruaati load chunenge, reps in reserve (RIR) aur rate of perceived exertion (RPE) istemal karenge, do-ke-do rule se ek waqt mein ek variable aage barhayenge, saade traffic-light se dard sambhalenge, aur mareez ko samjhayenge ke taqat size se pehle kyun aati hai.

text.en: Muscles, tendons and bones adapt to **loads that are a little higher than they are used to**. This is **progressive overload**. If the load is too light for too long, nothing changes; if it jumps too fast, tissue and pain complain. So every strength plan has the same five dials: **load, repetitions, sets, rest and frequency**, plus the speed of each repetition. The craft is turning one dial at a time, in the right order, and watching how the patient responds.
text.ur: Muscles, tendons aur haddiyan **aise loads par dhalti hain jo un ki aadat se thore zyada hon**. Yeh **progressive overload** hai. Agar load bohat der halka rahe to kuch nahi badalta; agar bohat jaldi barhe to tissue aur dard shikayat karte hain. Isliye har strength plan ke wohi paanch dial hain: **load, repetitions, sets, rest aur frequency**, saath har repetition ki raftar. Hunar yeh hai ke ek waqt mein ek dial sahi tarteeb se ghumayein, aur dekhein mareez kaisa jawab deta hai.

text.en: Think of the **volume knob on a radio**. You do not go from silent to full blast in one turn, and you do not leave it at a whisper forever. You raise it a notch, listen, and only then raise it again. Progressive overload is turning the knob, and your patient's response is what you listen to.
text.ur: Radio ke **volume knob** ko sochein. Aap khamoshi se ek dam poori awaz par nahi jate, aur hamesha sargoshi par bhi nahi chhorte. Ek notch barhate hain, sunte hain, aur phir dobara barhate hain. Progressive overload knob ghumana hai, aur mareez ka jawab woh hai jo aap sunte hain.

title.en: Reps in reserve (RIR): how many more good repetitions the patient could do
title.ur: Reps in reserve (RIR): mareez mazeed kitni achhi repetitions kar sakta tha

rows.en: Very easy, could do many more
rows.ur: Bohat aasaan, bohat si mazeed kar sakta tha

rows.en: Warm-up, learning the movement, first session
Starting point for most beginners, older or deconditioned patients
rows.ur: Aksar beginners, buzurgon ya deconditioned mareezon ke liye aaghaaz

rows.en: Hard but controlled, two left in the tank
rows.ur: Mushkil lekin qabu mein, do reps baqi

rows.en: Main working sets once technique is good
rows.ur: Technique achhi hone par asal working sets

rows.en: Short blocks for stronger, healthy patients under supervision
rows.ur: Mazboot, tandurust mareezon ke liye nigrani mein chhote blocks

rows.en: Failure, could not do another good repetition
rows.ur: Nakami, ek aur achhi repetition nahi kar sakta tha

title.ur: Bina flare-up ke aage kaise barhein

steps.title: Start by effort, not by guesswork
steps.detail: Pick a load where the patient finishes the set with about three to four reps left. Most beginners start with 8 to 12 repetitions, older or very deconditioned patients with lighter loads and 10 to 15. || Andaze se nahi, effort se shuru karein

steps.title: Move one dial at a time
steps.detail: First add repetitions within the target range, then raise the load, then add a set. Changing two things at once hides what caused a flare-up. || Ek waqt mein ek dial

steps.title: Use the two-for-two rule
steps.detail: When the patient can do two extra repetitions on the last set in two sessions in a row, raise the load a small step (for example, the next smallest weight). || Do-ke-do rule

steps.title: Watch the next-day response
steps.detail: Check pain, swelling and function the next morning. If they settle quickly, progress; if they flare, hold the load or step back one notch. || Agle din ka jawab dekhein

question.en: A patient can do the planned 3 sets of 10 leg presses with about 4 reps left on every set, two sessions in a row. What is the best next step?
question.ur: Mareez lagatar do sessions mein har set mein takreeban 4 reps baqi rakhte hue 3 sets of 10 leg presses kar leta hai. Agla behtareen qadam kya hai?

text.en: Add two more exercises and three more sets at once
text.ur: Ek saath do mazeed exercises aur teen mazeed sets

feedback.en: Changing many things at once hides the cause of any flare-up.
feedback.ur: Bohat si cheezein ek saath badalne se flare-up ki wajah chhup jati hai.

text.en: Raise the load a small step and keep the repetitions the same
text.ur: Load chhote qadam se barhayein aur repetitions wahi rakhein

feedback.en: Yes — the work is easy for two sessions, so the load should go up gradually.
feedback.ur: Haan — kaam do sessions se aasaan hai, isliye load tadreeji taur par barhna chahiye.

text.en: Keep the same load for another month to be safe
text.ur: Mehfooz rehne ke liye ek aur mahine wahi load

feedback.en: Too little challenge stops the muscle from adapting.
feedback.ur: Bohat kam challenge muscle ko dhalne se rokta hai.

question.en: A patient has mild pain (3 out of 10) during a squat that settles within an hour and is no worse the next morning. How do you read this?
question.ur: Mareez ko squat ke dauran halka dard (10 mein se 3) hota hai jo ek ghante mein theek ho jata hai aur agli subah zyada nahi. Aap ise kaise parhein?

text.en: Acceptable: continue, and progress cautiously as pain stays settled
text.ur: Qabil-e-qubool: jaari rakhein, aur dard theek rehne par ehtiyat se aage barhein

feedback.en: Yes — a small, brief rise in pain that settles quickly is usually a safe response in rehabilitation.
feedback.ur: Haan — dard ka chhota, mukhtasar izafa jo jaldi theek ho jaye rehab mein aam taur par mehfooz jawab hai.

text.en: Double the load to push through it
text.ur: Dard ko par karne ke liye load dugna

feedback.en: Raising the load without a settled response invites a flare-up.
feedback.ur: Jawab theek hone ke baghair load barhana flare-up ko dawat dena hai.

text.en: Stop all exercise for a week

feedback.en: Rest is not needed for a settled mild rise in pain.
feedback.ur: Theek hone wale halke izafay par aaram ki zaroorat nahi.

question.en: A patient with a sore tendon cannot do repeated reps without sharp pain but can hold a position. What is a reasonable early option?
question.ur: Dukhte tendon wala mareez bar bar reps tez dard ke baghair nahi kar sakta lekin position ko pakar sakta hai. Shuruaati munasib option kya hai?

text.en: Fast, bouncing repetitions to warm the tendon
text.ur: Tendon ko garam karne ke liye tez uchhalti repetitions

feedback.en: Fast, jerky loading is the worst for an irritable tendon.
feedback.ur: Tez jhatke wali loading chirchire tendon ke liye sab se buri hai.

text.en: Complete rest until there is no pain at all
text.ur: Jab tak bilkul dard na ho mukammal aaram

feedback.en: Total rest weakens the tendon and the muscle.
feedback.ur: Mukammal aaram tendon aur muscle ko kamzor karta hai.

text.en: Isometric holds at a tolerable effort, then progress to slow, heavy repetitions as pain allows
text.ur: Qabil-e-bardasht effort par isometric holds, phir dard ke mutabiq dheeri, bhaari repetitions

feedback.en: Yes — holds let the muscle work with less pain, and progression follows as tolerance rises.
feedback.ur: Haan — holds muscle ko kam dard mein kaam karne dete hain, aur bardasht barhne par progression aati hai.

text.en: **Staying light forever, or leaping heavy overnight.** A patient who curls the same two-kilogram dumbbell for three months is not training; a patient who doubles the leg press at the first session is asking for a flare-up. Both come from not using effort and the next-day response as guides. Plan a small progression every one to two weeks and write it down.
text.ur: **Hamesha halka rehna, ya raat bhar mein bhaari chhalang.** Jo mareez teen mahine ek hi do kilo dumbbell se curl karta hai woh training nahi kar raha; jo pehle session mein leg press dugna kar leta hai woh flare-up ko dawat de raha hai. Dono is liye hote hain ke effort aur agle din ka jawab rehnuma nahi banaye jate. Har ek se do haftay mein chhoti progression plan karein aur likhein.

text.en: **Explain "good" and "bad" effort.** For example: "Your muscles should feel tired and warm, and a mild ache is fine if it settles within a few hours. Sharp, pinching, catching or growing pain means we stop and change something. We raise the weight only when two sessions in a row feel easier." This keeps patients safe and makes them partners, not passengers.
text.ur: **"Achhi" aur "buri" mehnat samjhayein.** Misaal: "Aap ke muscles thake aur garam mehsoos hone chahiye, aur halka dard theek hai agar chand ghanton mein theek ho jaye. Tez, chubhta, atakta ya barhta dard ho to hum rukte hain aur kuch badalte hain. Hum wazan tab barhate hain jab lagatar do session aasaan lagen." Isse mareez mehfooz rehte hain aur musafir nahi, shareek banate hain.

question.en: Why does a patient get stronger in the first weeks even though the muscle is not visibly bigger?
question.ur: Pehle haftay mein mareez taqatwar kyun ho jata hai jabke muscle nazar aata bada nahi hota?

answer.en: Early strength gains come mostly from the nervous system: better recruitment of muscle fibres, better coordination and less braking. Muscle size changes more slowly, over many weeks. Telling patients this prevents disappointment, and explains why they feel stronger in the first fortnight even before the mirror shows it.
answer.ur: Pehle ki taqat ke izafay zyada tar nervous system se aate hain: muscle fibres ka behtar recruitment, behtar coordination aur kam braking. Muscle ka size dheere badalta hai, kai haftay mein. Mareezon ko yeh batana mayoosi se bachata hai, aur samjhata hai ke woh pehle pandrah din mein hi taqatwar kyun mehsoos karte hain, aaine mein nazar aane se pehle.

beats.patient: A 62-year-old woman with moderate knee osteoarthritis can do 10 sit-to-stands but finds stairs hard. She feels each rep at about RIR 4.
beats.assessment: Her programme is too easy and her function is limited by thigh strength. She is safe to train harder, and there is no sign of a flare-up.
beats.treatment: Move sit-to-stand to a lower seat or add a weight vest, add a leg press at RIR 3, train two to three times a week, and progress with the two-for-two rule. Teach breathing out on effort.
beats.reassess: After six weeks she takes the stairs with less pain, her knee is no worse, and her load has increased in small steps.

text.en: **Stop for the warning signs.** Chest pain, severe breathlessness, dizziness or fainting, sudden sharp joint pain, a snapping feeling in a tendon, numbness or severe unusual weakness mean stop and assess. Teach patients to breathe out on the effort and not hold their breath, especially those with high blood pressure or heart disease; check medicines that change heart rate or pressure.
text.ur: **Warning signs par rukein.** Seene ka dard, shadeed saans ki tangi, chakkar ya behoshi, achanak tez joint dard, tendon mein snap ka ehsaas, sunn ya shadeed ghair mamooli kamzori ho to rukein aur assess karein. Mareezon ko sikhayein ke zor lagate waqt saans bahar nikalein aur rokein nahi, khaaskar high blood pressure ya dil ke mareez; woh dawaiyan dekhein jo dil ki raftar ya pressure badalti hain.

text.en: The American College of Sports Medicine progression models describe how to progress load, repetitions and frequency over time in resistance training, with novices typically starting at moderate loads and moving up in small steps. A repetitions-in-reserve scale has been shown to track the true effort of a set in trained lifters, which makes it a practical way to prescribe effort without testing a one-repetition maximum. For tendon pain, a pain-monitoring model that allows tolerable pain which settles by the next day has been used successfully in tendinopathy. The evidence that isometric holds reduce tendon pain immediately is mixed.
text.ur: American College of Sports Medicine ke progression models batate hain ke resistance training mein load, repetitions aur frequency waqt ke saath kaise barhayein, jahan beginners aam taur par moderate load se shuru karte hain aur chhote qadmon mein aage barhte hain. Repetitions-in-reserve scale trained lifters mein set ki asal mehnat ko track karta hai, jo one-repetition maximum test kiye baghair effort dene ka amali tareeqa hai. Tendon dard ke liye pain-monitoring model jo qabil-e-bardasht dard ki ijazat deta hai jo agli subah tak theek ho jaye, tendinopathy mein kamyabi se istemal hua hai. Isometric holds tendon dard ko foran kam karte hain is ke saboot mila-jula hai.

text.en: **Effort, One dial, Two-for-two, Next day.** Set the effort, turn one dial, apply the two-for-two rule, and read the next-day response.
text.ur: **Effort, Ek dial, Do-ke-do, Agla din.** Effort tay karein, ek dial ghumayein, do-ke-do rule lagayein, aur agle din ka jawab parhein.

summary.en: Progress strength by effort: start with three to four reps left, change one variable at a time, and raise the load with the two-for-two rule.
summary.ur: Taqat ko effort se barhayein: teen se chaar reps baqi se shuru, ek waqt mein ek variable badlein, aur do-ke-do rule se load barhayein.

summary.en: Mild pain that settles within hours and is not worse the next day is usually acceptable; sharp or growing pain means stop and change something.
summary.ur: Halka dard jo ghanton mein theek ho aur agle din zyada na ho aam taur par qabil-e-qubool hai; tez ya barhta dard ka matlab rukna aur kuch badalna hai.

summary.en: Early strength gains are nervous-system gains; muscle size follows later, so explain this to patients.
summary.ur: Shuru ki taqat ke izafay nervous system ke hote hain; muscle ka size baad mein aata hai, isliye mareezon ko samjhayein.

back.en: Reps in reserve: how many more good repetitions you could do.
back.ur: Reps in reserve: aap mazeed kitni achhi repetitions kar sakte thay.

back.en: Raise the load when two extra reps are possible on the last set in two sessions in a row.
back.ur: Lagatar do sessions mein aakhri set mein do mazeed reps ho sakein to load barhayein.

back.en: One at a time: reps, then load, then sets.
back.ur: Ek waqt mein ek: pehle reps, phir load, phir sets.

front.en: Why do patients get stronger before muscles grow?
front.ur: Muscles ke barhne se pehle mareez taqatwar kyun hote hain?

back.ur: Nervous system ki adaptations pehle aati hain.

note.ur: Exercise ki dose ki bari tasveer.

note.ur: Dukhte tendon ko qadam ba qadam load karna.
